# **📝 List of Contents** 📍Own your collection management with CLO-SET [Line Sheet,](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) including everything from Garment Thumbnail to Sales Channel and Price information. **![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777844657305)** 1. Upload Content(s) 2. Viewing Line Sheet 3. Info by Content 4. Info by Colorway 5. Customizing Fields # **📓 Details** **1\. Upload Content(s)** --- * Start by uploading the Contents to be displayed in the Line Sheet. Click '+' from your dashboard * Find further instructions on [how to upload](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777844800665) **2\. Line Sheet Beta**[**(Full Line Sheet Guide)**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) --- * Line Sheet is available on multiple space levels, from Workroom and Assortment to Brand * Enter the space, and click Line Sheet Beta icon on the top right corner * The list of Contents to be displayed on the Line Sheet will vary depending on which [space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) you started. To view all Contents within a Brand, you must access Line Sheet from that Brand space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777854277657) * In Line Sheet, ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845221017) 1. **Path** : displays which space you are viewing, and the location of the space 2. **Viewing** **Mode** : switch between list and thumbnail mode to view the Line Sheet 3. **Table** **Fields** : fields may be editable on a Colorway or Content level * Find the detailed guideline on [**Line Sheet Table Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) _**💡 Notes**_ > Line sheet Thumbnail Mode
> > ![Screenshot_20221101_020628.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54993109060249) **3\. Info by Content** --- * Fields listed below are editable **by Content**(not editable for each Colorway) * [What is Content?](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303145393305) Editable by **Content** | * Content No. * Content Name * Workflow * Category * Material Composition * Tag * Description * Customer Type * Product Manager | ![editableCont1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845384089) ![editableCont2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845597593) ---|---|--- **4\. Info by Colorway** --- * Fields listed below are editable **by Colorway** Editable by **Colorway** | * Colorway * Status * Carryover * Quantity * Retail Intro Date * Retail Exit Date * Development Cost * Price * Sales Channel * Store Type * Store Name * Remark | ![editableCol1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777845796249) ![editableCol2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846070809) ---|---|--- **5\. Customizing Fields** --- ### 1) [Content Information](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) * Selective fields in Line Sheet are auto-filled based on the Content Information * Applicable: Content No / Content Name / [Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049) / Tags * [Fill in Content details](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) such as Workflow, Category, and Tags to effectively manage Content data * Please note: Changes made on Line Sheet will **NOT** be reflected back to the Content page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846347929) ### 2) Company Settings > Line Sheet * Selective fields are customizable for each [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) in CLO-SET * **Applicable** : Category / Workflow / Status / Sales Channel / Store Type * Enter Company > click Settings icon at the top left > click Line Sheet ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846511513) * Select the field to customize, and add/edit/delete fields to be used throughout the Comapny * Enter 'Category' tab to customize Category * Enter 'Content' tab to customize Workflow * Enter 'Line Sheet' tab to customize Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777856032793)
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide to managing your collection with CLO-SET's Line Sheet, detailing steps for uploading content, viewing line sheets, and customizing fields for effective collection management.

Billing | * Billing History * User History * Usage History | View invoice details & group member history. Data Intelligence | * User Activity * Content * Leadtime * Cost Saving | View usage statistics per user, including content views and rendering usage. In addition, view the analytics of your content leadtime and cost savings. Activity Log | * Rendering Log | Detailed Rendering usage and logs of the Group. Settings | * Group Settings * Permission Management * Team Management | Change Group name, profile, and add Group Operator. Find and delete permissions by user. Developer Page | | Create CLO-SET API token and trigger for your Group. **Details** ### 1) Subscription Information ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778533567385) * Find subscription information including Plan type, measurement period, next billing date, estimated billing amount, and payment method of your Group * Estimated Billing Amunt: All billing amounts are confirmed on the last day of your subscription, reflecting any changes in number of users within the Group. The displayed amount on this page may differ from what is actually billed on your next cycle. * To upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, click 'Change Plan' on the right * Once you click 'Change Plan', you will see a modal to select the new plan as the image below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778533851161) * To change your credit card information, click 'Change' ### 2) Usage ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778534240409) * Find Usage details in your Group * User, Company, Workroom counts are displayed as 'total to date' * 'CLO Support' indicates any CLO Employees invited to the Group for support, and is excluded from your Group's bill. * File upload, Rendering, Embed View, and API Call counts displayed are 'current period usage' * Usage limit may differ for each Group based on the plan type. title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Construction
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732942489) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677355929) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944153) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944921) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- The Construction tab displays auto-generated markers and allows construction annotation for all Content Types that have been pre-set in CLO3D. CLO-SET Construction is integrated with all the materials, trims, and even sewing methods of the 3D garment made in CLO3D. * Data Sync from CLO3D BOM * Flexible modification, addition, and deletion of markers and their position * Easy-to-use annotation tools for texts and drawings * Availability of version updates as well as history tracking * Communicate with your partners, Share ideas, and Make final decisions for your outfits. ### 2\. How-To #### _Permission_ * * Admins: able to Edit and Delete others’ comments and annotations * Collaborators and Editors: able to Edit and Delete mine only ![construction_page_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945177) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.09_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945561)_Content Type Panel_ Add Pages for new Content Type 1. Click the ![AddPageIcon.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946201)button. 2. Select a Content Type Reorder Pages 1. Drag and Drop the Page as you would like. 2. Cover cannot be reordered. Delete & Duplicate Click on the ![dotdotdot.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677358617) and Duplicate or Delete as you wish. ![leftpanel.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946969) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.53.49_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359385)_Construction Viewer &![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.56_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947225)Construction/Comment Panel_ ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-01_at_5.09.25_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359897) To **Edit View Point** , click on the left icon to zoom in and zoom out and turn the camera with right click. * Rotation * Zoom In/Out * Camera Point * Keyboard Shortcuts To **Edit Drawing** , click on the right icon to make annotation drawings and add or delete markers. Please refer to the details of each feature from the left side of the Annotation Tool Bar. ![annotationToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947737) * ![pic.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677360409) Attach Image \- After clicking on the viewer window, the File Directory will appear. * ![move.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732948889) Click \- You can move and adjust around other annotations that you have already created. * ![input_text.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949273) Input Text * ![pen.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949785) Pen * ![straightline.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951065) Straight Line * ![curvedLine.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951705) Curved Line * ![oneArrow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732952473) One-sided Arrow * ![circle.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677363737) Circle * ![square.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732954265) Square * ![penColor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677364761) Toolpen Color * ![thickness.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677366169) Toolpen Thickness ![markerToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732955673) You can Add and Delete markers from the tool bar on the bottom of the 3D Viewer Window. ### ### **Examples** ![example2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368089)![example1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368473) ### 3\. Page Types 1. Cover Page ![cover.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368857) * Viewer panel shows the ‘front’ and the ‘back’ images that are generated when saving the garment as Zpac and Zprj * Construction Version shows the list of history versions as well as the Current Version. * Page Name is named default as Cover, and it can be modified. 2. Pattern Page ![Pattern.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677369753) * Page Name is named default as Pattern, and it can be modified. * The markers of Pattern start from P1, using the ‘P’ prefix from Pattern. * The Pattern Panel displays the parts of the Patterns used for each Fabric from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Pattern list is identical to the order of the Pattern from CLO3D. * The construction markers of Pattern _**cannot be added or deleted.**_ * On the bottom right corner of the viewer window, there is a Pattern Layout, which can be clicked to view. 3. Fabric Page ![fabricPage.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677370393) * Page Name is named default as Fabric, and it can be modified. * The markers of Fabric start from F1, using the ‘F’ prefix from Fabric. * The Fabric Panel displays the names of the Fabric used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Fabric list is identical to the order of the Fabric from CLO3D. 4. Graphic Page * Page Name is named default as Graphic, and it can be modified. * The markers of Graphic start from G1, using the ‘G’ prefix from Graphic. * The Graphic Panel displays the names of the Graphic used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Graphic list is identical to the order of the Graphic from CLO3D. 5. Button Head Page * Page Name is named default as Button Head, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Head start from B1, using the ‘B’ prefix from **B** utton Head. * The Button Head Panel displays the names of the Button Head used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Head list is identical to the order of the Button Head from CLO3D. * The count of Button Head is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHead.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732957849) 6. Button Hole Page * Page Name is named default as Button Hole, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Hole start from H1, using the ‘H’ prefix from Button **H** ole. * The Button Hole Panel displays the names of the Button Hole used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Hole list is identical to the order of the Button Hole from CLO3D. * The count of Button Hole is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHole.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677371417) 7. Zipper Page * Page Name is named default as Zipper, and it can be modified. * The markers of Zipper start from Z1, using the ‘Z’ prefix from Zipper. * The Zipper Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. * All parts of Zippers such as Zipper Puller, Zipper Slider, Zipper Teeth, Top Stopper, and Bottom Stopper, are shown in the Zipper Content Page. 8. Topstitch Page * Page Name is named default as Topstitch, and it can be modified. * The markers of Topstitch start from T1, using the ‘T’ prefix from Topstitch. * The Topstitch Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. 9. Etc. Page * Page Name is named default as Etc., and it can be modified. * The markers of Etc. start from E1, using the ‘E’ prefix from Etc. * The Etc. Panel displays the names of the Etc. items used from CLO3D, such as trm. obj, fbx, dae, glb, and others. 10. Blank Page * Page Name is named default as New Page, and it can be modified. * Markers are not created in Blank Page. * This Page is for flexible usage of annotations. ### ### 4\. Construction Versions * Web Tech Pack is created for each individual content in CLO-SET. * Web Tech Pack data is based on the Version Updates. * The data shown in Construction is the data of the ‘Current’ Version’s zpac, or zprj file. * The versions that have been ‘Version Updated’ on WTP are shown in Construction. * For example, ContentA has 5 versions. And, Version 1, 3, 5 has only been Version Updated in WTP, then the Construction also only shows Version 1, 3, 5. * Editing can only be done in the ‘Current Version’. The past versions are View Only. **![construction_page.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732959257)**
content_description: This web page provides an overview of the CLO-SET Web Tech Pack, showcasing its integration with 3D content from CLO3D to streamline tech pack creation and collaboration among users.

title: Workroom View
content:
# **Objective** Learn how to navigate CLO-SET Dashboard and utilize your Workroom Space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629223449) 1. Menus (Left Pane) 2. Space (Room View) 3. Comment, Share (Right Pane) 4. Content Interaction & Movement # **Details** ### 1) Menus (Left Pane) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777975520921) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 3.15.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778005716249) ---|--- **1\. Group Name** : See which Group you're currently in. To switch the Group, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group's name. The Blue Crown indicates that you are the Group Admin. **2\. Menu Tab** * Browse: View the space [hierarchy](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) and navigate to the desired Space * Workspace: View all Spaces by level. (ex. Click on 'Companies' to view all Company Space you have access to) * Console: View [Admin Console](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) for usage data, billing, and developer page. * [Favorites](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): View all Spaces and Contents you've marked as Favorite * [Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents using everyday words or an image. ### 2) Space (Room View) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629224217) **3\. Space Info** * Upload: Upload a new Content in current Workroom * Create: Create a sub-Space * Notifications: Turn notifications on/off for current Space * [Favorite](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): Mark/unmark the Space as Favorite * Navigation: Shows the hierarchy of the Space you are in **4.**[**Line Sheet**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289)** & **[**Data Intelligence**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303278347545) **5\. Space Name** : Name of the Space you are in (Brand | Workroom) **6.**[**Search Bar**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents within the Space **7.**[**Filter**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Filter the Contents you want to view 8\. View by: Shows by each content or clorway ### 3)Comment, Share (Right Pane) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992573410713) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777990897561) #### **Share to People** * [**Invite/Share**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303179603481): Invite or share with teammates * Invite: for Company/Brand * Share: for Workroom/Content * **Share with Link:** Turning this option on will convert the Space to public status. Be ware of the security implications when sharing with link. * **Accessible People** : View the list of teammates with access to this Space. This may include those with access to higher-level Spaces. For example, anyone with access to a Brand will be able to view all Workroom within the Brand. _**💡 Notes**_ > Download access for link-shared content (share with link) is limited to **Group Members only**. > Anyone with the link can still **view** , but only **Group Members can download** , even when **Enable Download** is turned on. #### **Workroom Comment** * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697). Please follow the hyperlink to view detailed Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777999005209) ### 4)Content Interaction & Movement #### 4-1) Selection Interaction (Single Click / Double Click) CLO-SET separates **item selection** and **page navigation** to prevent unintended actions. * **Single click** → Select item * **Double click** → Open item and navigate to its page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864050585) _**💡 Notes**_ > In the **Workroom** , a single click also allows you to **preview key content information** without opening the content page, making it easier to review details while browsing multiple contents.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600716195865) #### 4-2) Basic Selection Behavior #### Single Selection **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x2 | Double click on an item: opens the item ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x1 | Single click on an item: selects the item * Previously selected item will be deselected **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)**x1 | Single click on empty space: deselects all items * Applied to **all areas except Assortment, Dashboard, and Visual Board** #### #### Multi Selection (Workroom only) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880017433) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** **📝 Note** 1. **Context Menu** * The (…) button is disabled even when an item is selected. * Even if multiple items were previously selected, the selection will be cleared and only one item will remain selected. 2. **Popover Menu** * If a Workroom is included in the selection list, all actions except _deselect_ will be disabled. #### 4-3) Drag&Drop Move for Selected Contents Once contents are selected, they can be moved more efficiently using **drag &drop** interactions. #### #### Drag into a Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** * The contents will be moved to the target location ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880019609) #### #### Drag via Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864062361)
content_description: This webpage aims to provide users with a comprehensive guide on navigating the CLO-SET Dashboard and effectively utilizing their Workroom Space.

Version Update # # **Details** ### 1)Colorway/Grade/Version ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 11.30.12 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388740121) You may view the BOM data per Colorway, Grade, and Content Version * **Colorway** \- You may create new Colorway from CLO/MD software * **Grade** \- You may create new Grades in CLO3D software * **Version** \- When you upload a new version of the Content on CLO-SET, you can choose to update WTP information accordingly. * **[Important]** Information is managed and updated per **Colorway-Grade** combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. ### 2) Edit Material Detail ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.19.28 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374092313) * Non-Editable: Content ID (if uploaded on CLO-SET) / Name / Color / Texture / Marker are extracted from your zprj/zpac file. * Editable: Consumption / Unit Price / Total Price / Remark can be edited on WTP. This information will also be reflected on WTP - Cost Estimation tab * Material information may be added/edited/deleted per Colorway/Grading/Version per your selection. ### ### 3) Add Material Item ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.55.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374312601) **1\. Add Blank Row : Text-based Item** When you click on the **Add 1 blank row** , a new blank row is created. * * The **Name** can be edited. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.02.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328857625) * * The **Color** can be picked. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328860825) * * The **Texture** and **Marker** images can be uploaded. **![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.19 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263305690777)** **2\. Add Content Row : Item from CLO-SET** When you click on the **Add 1 content row** , a **Add Trim** pop-up is shown. You may browse through your Tree Menu or find Recent Trim files from your CLO-SET Group. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.57.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374487705) * Contents added directly from CLO-SET will be marked with a blue 'CLO-SET' icon next to the 'Name' as shown below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374664089) * Please note that the Content Type must match the type of material you want to add. For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric[ Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. * User must have 'Editor' or above [permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. * When adding a material from CLO-SET, it will load the latest version that matches the file format. * Version updates on the Trim files will NOT be reflected to the WTP automatically. If needed, please delete the old material and add it again. * If the Trim file is deleted in CLO-SET, the BOM table will mark the material as 'deleted'. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. You can not change/edit the Type after the upload. **WTP Section / Subsection** | **Content Type** | **File Format** ---|---|--- Fabric | Fabric | zfab Trim / Graphic | Graphic | jpg, jpeg, gif, png, bmp, raw, psd, ai, tif, tiff, svg Trim / Button Head | Button Head | btn Trim / Button Hole | Button Hole | bth Trim / Zipper | Zipper | zpl, zpu, zsd, zsl, zst, zss, zsp Trim / Thread | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Top Stitch | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Others | Etc | trm ### 4) Add/Delete Row ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 2.01.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374843673) You may delete/add rows on the BOM table. Right-click on the Row to either delete it or add new above/below the selected row. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 12.58.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328862361) To change the order of the rows, you may drag the No column cell and move around to adjust the ordering. _**💡 Notes**_ > _In order to view by colorway and grading in CLO-SETBOM, the content must have the corresponding data input from CLO3D colorway and POM._
> > _The name that will appear on BOM Colorway is the name you input in CLO._
> > _The Color chip that you see is the color chip of Fabric_
> > _If there are several fabrics, you will see the very first one on the top of the list._
> > _If you would like to switch around the order, you can simply drag and sort the order in CLO3D._ > > ![Newsletter_Scrapbook_-_Frame_15.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992281033113) ### 5) WTP Version Update * When you upload a [new version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP * If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a[ Style Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), * New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. * Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. * If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. * What does an 'update' mean in Web Tech Pack? * If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM * If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack * If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. * Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically * Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version * Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'.

For a single item, click the ⋯ (More) button and choose _**Add to Assortment**_ ; For multiple items, hold Ctrl/Cmd and click _**Assortment**_ from **the floating menu**. * Select an Assortment room to use on the space tree, or create new Assortment. Review Assortment** --- * Enter the Assortment to start * Adjust the layout with the sizing menu, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372352537) * Switch View Mode option, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** _The 3D view mode cannot be changed in bulk from the dropdown menu._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372353561) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393664153) * Switch View By options to adjust the Assortment layout _\- View By**Content** : displays 1 _[_default Colorway thumbnail_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) _of each Content_ _\- View By**Colorway** : displays each Colorway as a separate image_ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372356633) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372357529) * Active the **'Synchronized' camera** at the top menu bar, and hover over any Content to open the Turntable bar. Click **Create a Virtual Showroom** to add garments to a showroom space and display them. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393675161) _**💡 Note**_ > * **You can add Style Content to Assortment in Assortment page** > 1\. Click ![blobid1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989679944601) icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. > 2\. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT
> > > ![assortment.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989696561049)
> > * When content is deleted from the Workroom, it will appear as an unavailable thumbnail in the Assortment.
> > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54986851144729)
> > * Colorways created in the **Configurator** are displayed in the **Assortment Room**. > When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action.
> ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989852711193) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989859663513) > ---|--- **4\. Mix & Match Contents** --- [Mix & Match](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) the Contents to review the full outfit #### **1) How to use Mix &Match** 1\. Move the Content you want to Mix&Match to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&Match page. 2\. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3\. Click the ‘MIX AND MATCH’ Icon on the right top 4\. Load your items by drag-and-dropping into the viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550741273)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550749721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511745561) ### #### **2) Mixing & Matching Garments** * Drag and drop selected garments into the Mix & Match view * Combine any garments freely without category restrictions * Adjust garment placement to explore different outfit combinations ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550758169)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550760985) #### **3) Saving a Scene** * Save the final outfit combination as a **scene** * Saved scenes can be used for later review, feedback, or collaboration ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511752089)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511756313) #### **4) Tips** * We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. * You can freely add and combine multiple garments to explore different outfit variations.

content:
#### Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. # **Objective** Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. 1. Default Colorway 2. Custom View 3. Thumbnail Types & Rules 4. Thumbnail Change 5. PDF Thumbnail # **Details** CLO-SET offers two different thumbnail options of content. When uploading 3D files to CLO-SET, users can select either the "**Default Colorway"** or the **"Custom View"** option. ### ### **1) Default Colorway** **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778235562649)** * CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. * '**Deafult Colorway** ' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. * To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' ### **2) Custom View** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686255641) * Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. CLO-SET, supports thumbnail images and turntable images based on the Custom View. Link to set [Custom View](https://clo3d.zendesk.com/knowledge/editor/01JWB42WYFJTD6VSN6JS0ECPJP/en-us?brand_id=44407677825689&section_id=44750293195417) in CLO-SET. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only
> > saved for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including
> > **Linesheet** , **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnails in CLO-SET. ### **3) Thumbnail Types & Rules** * ### Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. **[Important]** All Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778259295897) * ### Workroom View **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778250198553) ![thumbnail3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286596121) * ### Assortment Assortment Thumbnail is shown based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286769689) ### 3) Thumbnail Changes * ### Change Thumbnail * Thumbnail in Content Information tab * Thumbnail in Workroom view * Turntable will NOT be updated ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287073433) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778251183641) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287393561) * ### Version Update * Uploading a new [Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. * To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. ![Group 134.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686257817) * ### Create New Version * Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page & Workroom View. * Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778272699801). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778294849945) * ### Delete Latest Version * * Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. ### 4) PDF Thumbnail * When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. * Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. * If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. * If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. * * Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778273168537) * * Workroom Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778295266329) > 💡 **Note:** Thumbnails on the Content Page can now be viewed in full screen. By clicking the **expand icon** located beneath the thumbnail, a new window will open, allowing to view a larger, clearer version of the image. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376979097) ### **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376984473)** ###

What is Visual Board? 2. User Scenario 3. Create 4. Edit Mode * Utilizing 3D Assets * Edit Mode UI 5. Invite & Share 6. Export to PDF 7. Permission & Notification 8. Users can now create Lookbooks or Moodboards with the 3D assets. * Create Lookbook, Moodboard, or Presentation with your Assets * Collaborate with your team online * Drag & Drop 3D assets to add 2D Images with a click ### 2) User Scenario ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774772003481) ### 3) Create Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor * From your dashboard, click on 'Workspace' > 'Visual Board' * Click '+' to create a new Visual Board * Enter the title and description, then click 'Create' * [Please Note] Only the creator of the Board & Group Admin will have access to the Board. Edit Toolbar:** add or edit components on/to your slide **Edit Toolbar** | **Bubble Toolbar** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819873689) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785684377) > 💡 Notes: Drawing Curved Line

Change Order** : Select the object(s) and right click to change the order. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774801962905) * **Single Select** : change the order of a single object. * Bring to front: bring the object to the very front of the slide * Bring forward: bring the object to move forward by 1 layer * Send to back: bring the object to the very back of the slide (excluding background) * Send backward: bring the object to move back by 1 layer * **Multi Select** : change the order of multiple objects together. Order among the selected objects will remain. * Bring to front: bring the objects selected the very front of the slide as a group * Send to back: bring the objects selected to the very back of the slide as a group (excluding background) **2\. Rotate & Flip **: All objects transformation “Rotate & Flip” available *** image, drawing (by pencil), line, shape, text (rotate only)** ![Group 137.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033270018841) * Free Rotate (15 degree by each pitch) by Handle UI with a Selected Object * Multi select “rotate & flip” available![06 - Object Rotation.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033297757465) **3\. Pen tool** : allows to draw precise lines and curves for more detailed visual expression * Draw both **straight lines and curves** using a single Pen Tool * Create more **precise and flexible shapes** for visual annotations and concept sketches * Edit shapes by adjusting points and curves for finer control ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819888025) **[Pen tool Key Features]** **1\. Flexible Shape Creation** 1. Draw straight lines by clicking points with Left Mouse Button (LMB) 2. Create curves by clicking, holding, and dragging with LMB 3. Close shapes to create filled areas **2\. Edit Mode** 1. **Enter/Exit** : Double-click (LMB) on any shape to enter Edit Mode 2. **Select and Move Points** : Click (LMB) to select and reposition individual anchor points 3. **Bezier Handle Editing** : Adjust curve handles (LMB) for precise curvature control 4. **Change Point Type** : Ctrl + LMB to toggle between corner and curve points. Click again to switch back. macOS: `Command + LMB` Windows: `Ctrl + LMB` 5. **Decouple Bezier Handles** : Alt + LMB for independent handle control (aligning them pairs them again) macOS: `Option + LMB` Windows: `Alt + LMB` 6. **Move Segments** : Select and drag segments (highlighted by two points) to adjust shapes 7. **Add Points** : Click anywhere on a segment to add a point. A snap guide will appear at the center of the segment for precise placement. 8. **Remove Points** : Select a point and press `Delete / Backspace` 9. **Multi-Select** : `Shift + LMB` to select multiple points simultaneously 10. **Delete Shape** : Select all points (or all except one) and press Backspace macOS: `Delete` Windows: `Backspace` ### 4) Invite & Share (Slide Show Mode) * **Add Editor** (Add Board Editor for collaboration) * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. * Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. * [Important]: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774830525337) * **Share & Publish** (Share the slide show with external users) * From Slide Show mode, click on the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner * **Restricted** : Only you and Can Edit member can access the slide show with link * **Publish** : Anyone with link can view the slide show ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774770667289) ### 6) Export to PDF ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774775546905) On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774817739033) * Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) * All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) ### 7) Permission & Notification * Permission to Visual Board * Please note: Group members are NOT automatically granted access to all Boards. You must be added as an Editor to each Board to view/make changes to unpublished Boards. ![visualboardpermission.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774802983577) * Notification * Manage notifications regarding Visual Board on [My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) * Notification sent to: Group Admin, Board Creator, and Board Editors (anyone added to each Board with 'Can Edit' permission) ### 8) Shortcut Keys **Key** | **Details** ---|--- Ctrl/Command + z Ctrl/Command + y | Undo Redo Ctrl/Command + a | Select all objects Shift + h Shift + v | Flip (horizontal) Flip (vertical) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188804737305) v i t b l p c | Select Tool Image Tool Text Tool Pencil Tool Line Tool Pen Tool Shapes Tool [ Ctrl/Command + [ ] Ctrl/Command + ] | Bring to front Bring forward Send to back Send backward

title: Global Unit Setting (Measurement & Currency)
content:
## **Objective** Understand Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) Setting. 1. What is Global Unit Setting 2. Managing global unit inconsistencies 3. Default Currency in Web Tech Pack / Content Page / Linesheet ## ## **Details** #### **1) What is Global Unit Setting?** Global Unit setting is an unified management of currency & measurement units at the company level. * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985562648601) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985578474009) ---|---|--- * In Settings, you can configure the Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) on the General Tab. It applies to the 2D Pattern Viewer and is synchronized with the Content Custom Field (Length) and Web Tech Pack (BOM, POM, and Cost Estimation tabs). ![ddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47495014053529)💡 **Note** > Global Unit Setting is applied at the company level.
> > User with **'Company Admin'** or '**Group Admin'** permission can modify these options. #### **2) Managing Global Unit Inconsistency** If the unit set in Company Settings differs from the unit of the file, a Modal will appear, indicating which unit is different. This modal is displayed in the following four cases: 1\. Mismatch when versioning up file![dddddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502634508057) 2\. Mismatch when uploading file ![GGGG.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502666844569) 3\. Mismatch when updating tech pack version ![ㅁㄴㅇ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502666846361) 4\. Mismatch when adding BOM item to the table ![ㅂㅈㄷㄱ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502634511257) #### #### **3) Unit Synchronization** Unit set in Company Settings is synchronized across various domains in CLO-SET. In the Web Tech Pack, the Global Unit is synchronized and displayed in the **"Overview"** , "**BOM"** and **"Cost Estimation"** tabs. 1\. Web Tech Pack Unit Synchronization Measurement Unit and Price Unit data are synchronized and displayed, with the price unit shown as the **"default currency"** in the top right corner. ![111.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362877721) If the price unit differs, both the **"default currency"** and the **"file currency"** are displayed simultaneously in the top right corner. ![222.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362878233) ![17.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878308633) 2\. The default currency is also displayed on the 'Content Page' and the 'Linesheet'. ![ㅁㅇㄹㅇㅁㄴㄹ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519868822297)![ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878310809)

content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET provides multiple options to help with the data management, including Category, Workflow, Tag, and Content Fields. Such fields are reflected on[ Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) and[ Line Sheet,](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) and can be utilized when [Searching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303232416793) Contents. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984769820441) 1. Workflow 2. Category 3. Tags 4. Description 5. Content Field Management (by clicking More Information) **• Category, Workflow** --- * Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com/), and click the Content to open the Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984764817049) * Enter the Content Page. You may assign a [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049) & [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) to each Content * **Category** : note the attributes of the Content such as Fabric, Trims, Avatars, and Garment types * **Workflow** : note which step the Content is on, in terms of the entire workflow ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778119912473) * Assign **Workflow** from the drop-down menu. Once clicked, it will be auto-saved * Click 'Edit' icon next to the **Category,** and select the attribute from the modal. Click OK to save ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778135833241) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778099290393) * **Bulk-assign** Category and Workflow from your Workroom. Start by selecting multiple Contents and click on Workflow or Category from the toolbar. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778136381081) * Both fields are **customizable** in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) tab. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778092913049) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778136840089) ---|---|--- * [Searching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303232416793) is also available by Category or Workflow **• Tag, Description** --- | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778093315097) | * **Tags** : save the keywords in hashtag form. For Style type Cotent, you can list data fields such as material composition, color, and price. * On the Content page, click 'More Information' button to open the Content Field Management tab ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778098466841) * [Content Fields](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) are customizable on the [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) tab ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778137290265)

content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Start communicating real-time on the auto-generated Web Tech Pack. * Opening a content page * Web Tech Pack - Tabs * Share & Export # **📓 Details** **![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777931380121)**| CLO-SET [Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777946851737) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777916704409) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777956966425) ---|---|--- **• Opening (.zprj / .zpac) File in the Content Page** --- * Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com), and click the Content to open the Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979411347097) * Enter the Content Page, and click Web Tech Pack icon ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979397582233) * A new tab will open. Switch between tabs to review & edit. Find more on the following guide![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777932283161) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979411347993) **• Web Tech Pack - Tabs** --- ***Important** : Web Tech Pack is created per [Content Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) (zprj/zpac only), and selecting 'update' will create a new version of Web Tech Pack. You can switch between versions on the WTP page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777968186265) ### ▶ Overview ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777948218905) * Overview tab provides basic information of the uploaded file. Find content information summary and mark the schedule to keep everyone on the same page * Information is auto-filled based on [Content Information](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) ### ▶ BOM ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777968577177) * **BOM** is auto-filled based on the 3D data of the .zprj/.zpac file * Double-click the field to make edits. Information is managed per Colorway-Grade combination * Add Trim information by clicking 'add' at the bottom of the page * Click the 'Export' button on the top right corner to download an Excel file ### ▶ Construction ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777948699801) * Review the construction of the design, and create [Annotations](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191080217) for feedback * For each page, automatic markers will be generated. Click the thumbnail image to view the detail * For patterns, the 2D pattern view will be displayed at the bottom right corner * Create [Comments](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303164021017) and tag the team for faster communication ### ▶ Measurement ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777933348377) * Measurement information is auto-filled based on the [POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716774-Create-POM) data of the .zprj/.zpac file * In the **Measurement tab** , you can manage additional measurement details such as: * HTM Comment (How To Measure notes) * Tolerance * Target values * On Web Tech Pack, users can mark the Target measurement for each POM field * The selected POM will be displayed in red on the garment in the left pane _**💡 Note**_ > For the content that does not contain measurement data, you can add the POM manually.
> > For more information, click [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303219189785) ### ▶ Cost Estimation ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777949107225) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777969348889) * **Cost Estimation** tab displays the estimated total cost for the design * Fabric and Trim costs are pulled from BOM tab * Add labor/transportation cost information at the bottom of the tab, and click 'apply to subtotal' to apply the changes made to the list at the top of the page * Add exchange rates for the broader team to refer to **• Share & Export** --- * [**Share** the Content](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176205081) with other users, to allow access to the Web Tech Pack * Exporting is available for Web Tech Pack. * To Export the **entire Web Tech Pack** Content, Export from **Overview** Tab as PDF or EXCEL (.excel will be available in end of August) * Export from **BOM** generates an Excel file * You can choose which colorway and grading to include (will be available in end of August) * Export from **Construction** generates a PDF file ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777959160473) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777984425241) _**💡 Note**_ > _MORE Detailed Instructions and Manual, please visit_[Web Tech Pack Full Guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385)
content_description: Discover how to seamlessly create, manage, and share your auto-generated Web Tech Pack with integrated 3D content for real-time collaboration in fashion design.

# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to use [Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) feature to standardize the Rendering results within the team. * What is Render Preset? * Upload Render Preset in CLO-SET * Using Render Preset * Render Preset Properties created inCLO # **📓 Details** **• What is Render Preset?** --- * Render Preset helps **standardize** the Render Properties for a cohesive output generation ![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778065909017)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Velvet Pink.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066040217)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Grey.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103367833)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778082594841) * Render Preset allows users to apply **detailed****Render Properties** when Rendering in CLO-SET[ ](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) in CLO3D [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066869657)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) | ▶ | in CLO-SET [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) ---|---|--- **• Upload Render Preset (.ZVRP) in CLO-SET** --- * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings > Rendering to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click **Upload File** to add a Render Preset. * You can **Add / Edit / Delete** presets here. * Up to **32 preset files** can be uploaded. * [Please note: Company Settings are accessible to Company Admin only](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878105) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878873) ---|---|--- _**💡 Note – How to Create a Render Preset File (ZVRP) From CLO Software**_ > Before uploading to CLO-SET, you need to create a **ZVRP (Render Preset) file** from **CLO software.**

> * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file
> * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties
> * A few requirements for CLO-SET:
> * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64
> * Image size must be less than 5,000px
> * Animation type can not be rendered
> * *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, sharing, and seamlessly carrying them through merchandising and production.
> **• Using Render Preset** --- * From your Dashboard, click the Content to open the Content page, where you can view the 3D Viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742879769) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753787417) * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778084170905) icon) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753788057) _**💡 Note**_ > Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon of the preset.
> > ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753789337) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937) > ---|---|--- **•**[**Render Preset Properties created in CLO**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) --- * #### To view the full list of properties saved in a ZVRP file from CLO, please visit [**Render Preset Guide**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778119339929)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129)

title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
content: # **Objective** Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 1. [File Format](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537) 2. Using 3D Viewer # **Details** ### 1) File Format **Type** | **Format** | **Description** ---|---|--- Garment | *.zpac | Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project | *.zprj | Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar | *.avt, .avte | Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ | *.obj | Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. GL Transmission Format | *gltf / glb | Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA | *.dae | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org/download.html](http://www.opencollada.org/download.html)) and export to use the avatar Fabric | *.zfab | Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button | *.btn | Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole | *.bth | Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim | *.trm | Contains material information Zipper Puller | *.zpl | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider | *.zsd | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper | *.zsp | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. CAD file | *.dxf | Contains 2D CAD pattern and grading data. Used to import garment patterns from external CAD systems into CLO. ### 2) Using 3D Viewer 1\. Enter [Dashboard](https://style.clo-set.com/), and click the '+' button to start ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936465039385) 2\. Select a file from your local drive. Choose one of the **supported file formats listed above** , then click **Upload**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455899289) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936465043737) 3\. Select a **Workroom**(**![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455903897))** to upload the file (Workroom is similar to folders in CLO-SET) * Click the ▶ button next to space names to expand * Select a Workroom (**![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455903897))** , and click 'Next' | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455905689) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455907481) ---|---|---|--- 4\. Once complete, find your Content on [Dashboard](https://style.clo-set.com/) or [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) (**![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455903897))** Double-click the **Content** in the Workroom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936465052953) 5\. You will be taken to the **Content page** , where you can view the detailed information of the content with the 3D viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54936455916057) For more instructions on how to use CLO-SET 3D Viewer, click [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537).
content_description: Discover the supported file formats for CLO-SET 3D Viewer and learn how to effectively upload and utilize your files within the platform.

New Colorway has been added under the 'Colorway' tab. Colorways added with CLO-SET Configurator will have the ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)icon. * When you hover over the new Colorway, you can also find the **Delete** button in the top-right corner. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289177625)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899247123225) ### 2) Color Editor * Pick a Color from palette to apply on your design * Reset the color by 'Reset color' button at the bottom * Click 'Create' to save the new colorway * Upload a [Color Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) to be shared with your team. **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** | **CUSTOM** ---|---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776421537817) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454140569) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776464361881) | ![CUSTOM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776469977241) ### 3) Texture Editor ## ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.40.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454757273) * Upload a Texture image * Adjust the texture using: * Gizmo on the style * Position/Scale/Rotation button on Configurator * Use Desaturation option * Reset Texture or Create new colorway ### 4) Property Editor ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.49.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465069977) * Edit the Property of the file - Opacity, Roughness, Intensity, or Metalness * Click 'Reset Property' to reset it to match the original file * Click 'Create' to create a new colorway ### 5) Create New Version * Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway(created with Configurator) compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776423191449) 1. **Add Colorway** : Create a new Colorway to be added on your Colorway list on the right pane. Colorways made with Configurator will have the ![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057) icon. 2. **Save** : After editing color, texture, or properties, click **Save**. Once saved, you can exit the **Configurator** tool and use other **3D Viewer** options (Exploded View, Schematic Render, etc.) for review. 3. **Create New Version** : Create a new [Version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) including the new Colorways made with Configurator. Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776482977305) *Please note: for ZFAB files, you may only create a new version. Adding a new Colorway to the original file is unavailable. ### 6) Downloading the New Colorway Select 'All Colorways' option to download a new .ZPRJ file including both the 1) Colorway from your original content, and 2) new Colorways created with configurator (![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)) ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465404697) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776471201689) ---|---|--- * Choose the version you wish to download. **Hover over the version tab > click on ••• > select 'All Colorways'** * 'Original Content' option will only include colorways from your original zprj file * Upload the new zprj file to use: Render, Web Tech Pack, Line Sheet, Embed/Fitting ### 7) Best Practice Workflow ![configtable.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776483159321) * **3D Garment** : Create new Colorways with Configurator, and create new Version to create production materials such as Render and Tech Pack. * **Block Pattern** : Start from a block pattern to create new Colorways for a new season. * **ZFAB** : create new patterns or color options for an existing ZFAB file in CLO-SET.
content_description: Explore the CLO-SET Configurator to seamlessly collaborate on and customize design options, including colors, textures, and properties for your 3D files.

title: Console - Permission Management
content: ## 📝 **List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to manage user access and permissions in the Admin Console. * Access Admin Console * Search * Change Permission * Remove Access > ###### _Permission:![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778737061017) Group Admin, Group Operator_ # **📓 Details** **•Access Admin Console** --- 1\. Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com/) and click **Console** button from the left navigation menu. 2\. Admin Console shows the **Summary** , **Billing** , **Data Intelligence** , **Activity Log** , **Settings** , and **Developer Page**. 3\. Click **Permission Management** from the tree menu. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053007257) _**💡 Notes**_ > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061560857) #### **•Search** --- **1\. Search by keyword (Name & Email)** * Enter the user’s **name or email** in the keyword field, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched user’s **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061561881) **2\. Search by space (including subspace is available)** * Click **Select a Space** in the Space section. * In the pop-up window, choose the space you want from the **menu tree** , then click **Next**. * Confirm that the correct space is selected, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched users’ **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053016089) *Search filter is not provided to Group Operator. Only Group Admin can use the 'Space' filter. **3\. Search by content** * Click the toggle button in the **Content** section to switch it from **Off** to **On**. * Click **Select a Content** and choose the content you want to search for. * Confirm that the correct content is selected, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched users’ **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061567641) ### **•Change Permission** --- ##### **1\. Collaborator ↔ Admin** * ##### **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * ##### Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * ##### Select **Change to Admin** or **Change to Collaborator**. **![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722435225)** **2\. Viewer ↔ Editor** * **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * Select **Change** to open the **Change Permission** pop-up. * Click the **drop-down menu** and choose the permission (**Can edit** or **Can view**). * Click **Confirm** , and the permission will be updated. **![mceclip5.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769053337)** **•Remove Access** --- ##### **1.****Delete user (Single/Multiple) - Remove access from all spaces** > Removes the selected user’s **access to all assigned spaces**. * Click the **checkbox** on the left side of the user information to select the user. * Click the **Delete** button. * Select **OK** in the pop-up window to remove the user’s access completely. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053023513) **2\. Remove access by space** **\- Remove access from a specific space or content** * **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * Select **Remove** to revoke the user’s access to that space. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053024665)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on managing user access and permissions in the Admin Console, including steps for accessing the console, searching for users, changing permissions, and removing access.

content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Share how to learn spaces, such as Workroom, Company, or Brand. * Share Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776498983321)) * Share Company / Brand * Permission System # **📓 Details** **• Share Workroom**(![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776498983321)) via Email --- ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54913663425049) 1. Click **Browse** , then select the **Workroom** you want to share from the menu tree. 2. Once in the **Workroom** , click the **Share** button on the right pane. (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776501122585)) 3. Enter the email of the recipient, and select permission (Editor or Viewer) * Find details on Editor/Viewer on 'Permissions System' below 4. Click 'Share', and recipient will receive an email notification _💡**Alternative: Share via Link**_ > ##### Turn on **Share with Link** and select **Anyone can view** to publish the Workroom and share it via URL. Anyone with the link can view the content, but only **Group Members** can download.
> > ##### Download access for link-shared content is limited to **Group Members only**. > Anyone with the link can still **view** , but only **Group Members can download** , even when **Enable Download** is turned on.
> > ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776559536281) **• Share Company / Brand** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54913674648345) 1. Click **Browse** , then select the **Company** or **Brand** you want to share from the menu tree. 2. Once in the **Company** or **Brand** , click the **Share** button on the right pane. (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776501122585)) 3. On the right pane, enter the email of the recipient, and select permission (Admin or Collaborator) * Find details on Editor/Viewer on 'Permissions System' below 4.
